metadata.title: Isometric Embeddings of Hyperkähler $\mathrm{T}^*\mathbb{CP}^{n}$
metadata.abstract: We construct explicit $U(n)$-equivariant isometric embeddings $T^*\mathbb{CP}^{n-1} \hookrightarrow \mathbb{R}^{n^4+2n^2-1}$, $n\ge 2$, with respect to Calabi's hyperkähler metric on $T^*\mathbb{CP}^{n-1}$. To achieve this, we first construct a diffeomorphism from $T^*\mathbb{CP}^{n-1}$ onto the manifold of rank-1 projections in $M_n(\mathbb{C})$, such that the pullback of half of the trace-class norm is a Kähler potential for the hyperkähler metric. We then use the Hilbert space structure of $M_n(\mathbb{C})$ to produce the isometric embeddings into Euclidean space.
metadata.comment: This preprint has been accepted into the Journal of Geometry and Physics. It is a more focused and streamlined version of a previous preprint

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对n≥2，以Calabi超Kähler度量为源，构造U(n)等变等距嵌入T*CP^{n−1}→R^{n⁴+2n²−1}。先将余切丛微分同胚到M_n(C)中秩一投影所成流形，使一半迹类范数的拉回成为该超Kähler度量的Kähler势，再利用矩阵空间Hilbert结构给出Euclidean嵌入。
analysis.breakthrough: 对非紧超Kähler模型给出可计算的等变等距实现。
analysis.limitations: 摘要公式源空间是T*CP^{n−1}，不能按标题误写CP^n；目标维数是一个实现上界，不声称最小嵌入维数。秩一投影的具体非自伴约定须正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。完整8页关键词和点写/任意断行连字模型名/Danus补检无AI候选，第7页Acknowledgments仅感谢住宿与个人支持，无自用AI披露；未观察到声明不等于确认未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊度量和显式外蕴几何，较高优先。
